I am a Senior Economist at the Central Bank of Ireland, having returned from the European Central Bank in 2026. My research focuses on banking, artificial intelligence, financial stability, systemic risk, and the international transmission of macroeconomic and financial shocks.

**Research interests** Banking, artificial intelligence, financial stability, systemic risk, investment dynamics, and international macro-financial transmission

[Research](research.qmd) | [CV](cv.qmd) | [Data](data.qmd) | [Contact](contact.qmd)

:::

## Publications

::: {.featured-list}

::: {.pub-item}
**The Macroeconomics of AI Capacity: Insights from a Two-Asset Growth Model** (2026)  
Jonathan Rice  
*Macroeconomic Dynamics*, 30, e22  
<span class="pub-links">
[Cambridge Core](https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/macroeconomic-dynamics/article/abs/macroeconomics-of-ai-capacity-insights-from-a-twoasset-growth-model/BA6A3F533F88E96FD0E7E09B1B0CA049)
[DOI](https://doi.org/10.1017/S1365100526100911)
</span>

A two-asset growth model of AI capacity, hardware obsolescence, investment dynamics, and welfare-relevant policy tradeoffs.
:::

::: {.pub-item}
**Riding the Rate Wave: Interest Rate and Run Risks in Euro Area Banks During the 2022-2023 Monetary Cycle** (2026)  
Jonathan Rice, Giulia Maria Guerrini  
*Journal of International Money and Finance*, 160, 103444  
<span class="pub-links">
[Journal](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0261560625001792)
[ECB Working Paper](https://www.ecb.europa.eu/pub/pdf/scpwps/ecb.wp3090~4852851923.en.pdf)
[SSRN](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=5383748)
</span>

Evidence on how the 2022-2023 tightening cycle affected euro area banks' economic net worth and deposit-run risk.
:::

::: {.pub-item}
**Economic Policy Uncertainty Shocks in Small Open Economies: A Case Study of Ireland** (2023)  
Jonathan Rice  
*The Economic and Social Review*, 54(4), 217-245  
<span class="pub-links">
[Journal](https://www.esr.ie/article/view/2531)
[PDF](https://www.esr.ie/article/view/2531/771)

An empirical study of how policy uncertainty shocks transmit through a small open economy.
